name: clinical-evidence
description: Clinical evidence synthesis and protocol review. Two co-designed skills — research-summary and protocol-reviewer — share a single evidence-search agent that gathers and verifies PubMed/Scholar Gateway/guideline evidence into a hidden reference ledger. research-summary is the user-facing entry point for a literature search or evidence summary and writes the narrative document plus Zotero exports; protocol-reviewer reviews an uploaded clinical protocol against the same evidence. The ledger handoff is invisible to the researcher. Designed for UK NHS clinical context with ISO 42001 transparency disclaimers.
